evidence.s1: The label stays light with dark ink or dark with light ink through all eight works; the record separates source, footprint tone and rendered levels and reports passing line floors.
evidence.s2: The first view contains one named Label window with two transport ornaments, not a field of decorative tiles, in both schemes.
evidence.s3: The record gives thickness 8 and a 461 px shorter window span; the 52 px ornaments retain readable labels in light and dark.
evidence.s4: The painting stays fixed and visible above, beside and below the Label while the middle and bottom captures scroll only its contents in both schemes.
evidence.s5: The record declares regular only across Label, Rooms and Guide; the light/dark captures show a consistent material family.
evidence.s6: Neither the Label nor its two ornaments uses clear glass; the record explicitly declares regular only.
evidence.s7: The room navigation and audio transport carry no coloured tint in any light/dark work phase.
evidence.s8: The light Label visibly carries painting colour and structure, and the record identifies runtime material rather than an opaque replacement or authored blur.
evidence.s9: Label uses a fixed 32 px radius, the two ornaments are capsules, and the record derives data, image and button radii from their containers.
evidence.s10: The bottom data fill follows the Label corner with an even inset in both schemes; its recorded radius is 18 from 32 minus 14.
evidence.s11: The floating transport housings and their bordered controls are capsules, particularly clear in the light forced-colours capture.
evidence.s12: Previous/index/next share the Rooms housing while audio has a separate Guide housing, forming only two groups below the Label in both schemes.
evidence.s13: The Rooms ornament’s text index button, “1 / 8”, shares one glass background with the previous and next icon buttons in light and dark.
evidence.s14: Material belongs to the Rooms and Guide housings rather than separately glazing their labels, icons or progress ring in either scheme.
evidence.s15: Related transport items read as one material per housing, and the two housings stay deliberately separated by the recorded 24 px gap in both schemes.
evidence.s16: The Label’s middle and bottom captures show child clipping and inner-edge fades, with the window outline and both bottom ornaments stationary in light and dark.
evidence.s17: Even Fog has visible painting variation behind the bodies; the Label and ornaments remain substantial surfaces rather than invisible outlines in both schemes.
evidence.s18: The essays and transport labels stay legible across the eight light/dark works; the record’s worst measured label-window line is 6.34:1.
evidence.s19: The reduced-transparency capture retains the essay and transports; the record documents policy handling and a live Reduce Motion flip cutting a running dissolve.
evidence.s20: The record paints footprint-shaped dark washes beneath regular glass, up to 0.82 strength in the dark scheme, outside the rule’s clear-media or modal dimming allowance.
evidence.s21: unread: the stationary Label and transport captures contain no press state, and the record’s reference to runtime press does not establish pointer-local glow and flex.
evidence.s22: The bottom navigation, audio labels and icons are monochrome in both schemes; saturated colours belong to the paintings.
evidence.s23: Transport labels use dark ink on light housings or light ink on dark housings, remaining distinct from ice, golden shore and blue-green water.
evidence.s24: The Label essay, metadata and bold weather heading use weighted readable ink in both schemes; the record specifies primary ink, weights 500–700 and per-line gating.
evidence.s25: The data section is a darker child fill in both bottom-scroll captures, not nested glass, and the recorded Rooms selection uses a lighter interactive fill.
evidence.s26: Rooms and Guide align within the Label width below its edge without overlap; their recorded overlay groups use a 64 px derived gap, opening under reduced transparency.
evidence.s27: Each work’s small opaque whole-work image sits inside the Label in both schemes; the record gives its concentric 4 px frame radius at the 28 px inset.
evidence.s28: The Label and transports use no coloured lightweight accent or thin accent mark in either scheme; their hierarchy is typographic.
evidence.s29: The Label and ornaments are untinted; the changing paintings, rather than branded window fills, provide the page’s identity in both schemes.
evidence.s30: The CSS and forced-colours views retain essay, image outline and transport marks; the record reports two-layer at DPR 1/about 0.355 M px, collapsed at DPR 2/about 1.42 M, and uncalibrated window scale.
